author: Edgar Allan Poe
title: The Raven and Other Poems
edition: New York: Wiley and Putnam, 1845. Original printed poem text transcribed by the Edgar Allan Poe Society of Baltimore; each selection locator names its individual transcription URL. HTML markup, page-location labels and modern double-bracket correction suggestions are excluded while the printed words preceding them remain. HTML entities decoded and layout spaces normalized; poetic line and stanza boundaries preserved. The library text holds the whole 1845 volume: the dedication, preface, every poem, the Politian scenes, POEMS WRITTEN IN YOUTH and Poe's notes.

rights.basis: The original-English text in this 1845 edition was published well before 1931 and its US term has expired. The repository reproduces the dated 1845 printed edition; modern editorial notes and page labels are excluded.

acquisition.method: Edgar Allan Poe Society of Baltimore XHTML pages for the 1845 printing, fetched in the volume's contents order and hashed as one concatenation in this order: https://www.eapoe.org/works/editions/raopc.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/editions/raopded.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/misc/raoppref.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/ravenj.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/valleye.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/bridale.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/sleeperh.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/colisemj.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/lenoref.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/hymng.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/israfelf.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/drmlandc.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/zantee.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/cityseae.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/paradsm.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/eulaliee.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/toe01f.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/francese.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/silencef.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/cwormf.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/palacej.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/politnd.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/sciencej.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/aaraafk.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/tamerlnh.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/dreame.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/romanceg.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/fairylh.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/to02d.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/riverg.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/lakef.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/songf.htm, https://www.eapoe.org/works/poems/tohelnf.htm. The first page (title page and contents) gives the level-1 heading; from every other page only the transcription panels (pnltextm) are converted, leaving out the site navigation, the society's headers, notes and variant listings. Page-location labels, the Society's double-bracket correction suggestions (the printed words before them kept), its bracketed statements of where footnotes fall, its [[Footnotes]] headings and one bracketed attribution it adds to a note ([William Shakespeare]) are removed; ornament rows and the half-title repeated on page 1 are dropped; HTML entities decoded, thin and layout spaces normalised to single spaces, italics and small capitals rendered as plain text. Poem and section titles are headings (level 2; the poems after POEMS WRITTEN IN YOUTH. at level 3), the scene numbers of Politian level-3 headings, and the Al Aaraaf part labels, stage directions, preface prose and the dedication (its lines kept) paragraphs; each run of verse lines up to a stanza break is a stanza with indentation removed. Poe's footnotes follow the poem as the Society places them, each in the form [Footnote mark: text] with the printed mark (a note running over several blocks closes its bracket on the last), and their references keep the printed mark in the running text.
